title: Hat of Fire Acuity

sources.title: Fire Acuity
markers: | summary = '''Fire Acuity''' is a passive feature that increases your spell power after dealing fire damage.

summary: Dealing Fire damage gives 2 turns of Arcane Acuity once per attack.

fields.Arcane Acuity: Gain +1 to spell attack rolls and spell save DC per remaining turn, up to 10. Taking damage removes 2 turns.
fields.Trigger example: Each separately rolled ray of Scorching Ray can apply Fire Acuity.
fields.Base value: 90 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
